$comment: Copy to your project root as flow.config.json. EVERY key is optional: what you omit is autodetected. This file always wins over autodetection.

commands.$comment: {target} is substituted with a single test file or test id. Bounded verification is the point: never the whole suite inside an implementation step.

plan.$comment: openspec = openspec/changes/<change>/{proposal,design,tasks,specs}. tasks-md = a plain tasks.md with checkboxes.

tracker.$comment: none = tasks.md checkboxes are the state. beads = also sync/close Beads issues (requires the bd CLI).

models.$comment: Per-agent routing. On a subscription this does not lower the bill -- it frees the scarce Opus quota. Mechanical work does not need Opus; review does.

limits.$comment: maxTaskSteps is the anti-runaway cap: a task is implemented as at most N short, FRESH agents handing off a compact ledger, instead of one agent running 200+ turns and re-reading a bloated context every turn.

worktree.$comment: Each run gets its own git worktree + branch, merged to the base branch only on approval. A bad run leaves an ugly branch, not a broken main.

retrieval.$comment: auto = use graphify if an index exists, otherwise plain search. Presence is probed; a missing tool degrades the flow, never breaks it.

verify.$comment: For frontend subtypes, 'rendered' requires real browser verification (Playwright / Claude-in-Chrome) instead of unit tests alone -- 'the tests pass but the UI is broken' is the failure this catches.
